## Checklist

- [ ] This targets `develop` (hotfixes for a shipped version target `main`)
- [ ] `php artisan test` passes and new behavior has a test
- [ ] `vendor/bin/pint` is clean
- [ ] Works on SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB and PostgreSQL
- [ ] No IP addresses or other personal data are stored
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an `[Unreleased]` entry for user-facing changes
- [ ] Interface changes include a screenshot and work in light and dark and on a phone
